summary: Iteration 48: Fee PnL Fix and Early Exit Timing Fix - 28/28 tests passed. Verified TWO BUG FIXES: (1) _calc_pnl now deducts entry_fee + exit_fee from raw PnL. LINKUSDT SHORT example: entry=8.555 exit=8.550 qty=2.5 fee_rate=0.001 → raw=$0.0125, fees=$0.0428, net=-$0.03 (matches Bybit). _calc_pnl_pct deducts 2*fee_rate*100 from percentage. (2) 1H preset early_exit_bars changed from 6 to 90 (~3 hours with 600s cycle). ExitEngine early_exit now uses max(atr_min_profit, fee_per_unit) to ensure min_profit covers trading fees. Config verified: fee_rate=0.001, leverage=5, 1h.early_exit_bars=90. All regression tests passed: TRAILING_EXIT, HARD_SL, TP_CAP still work correctly.
